content: Mehn Mohap ako kadarala sihmpwul men nin duwen kisakis ehu ong ih me ketin kakaun nan Serusalem, re kadarala sang nan kahnimw Sela nan sapwtehno.
Re ahpw awiawih ni keilen Pillap Arnon oh sehsehla soandi duwehte menpihr me kin kerewen sang nan pasarail.

Re ahpw ndahng mehn Suda, “Kumwail ndahdo mahs dahme se pahn wia. Kumwail doareikitala duwehte tuhke pwoat me mweteh kin kalamwurih wasa ni ahnsoun karakar en ketipin, oh mweidohng se en rukula pahn mwetehmwail. Kiht aramas ekei me sopohsangehr apwal; kumwail ekihkitala wasa me sohte emen kak diar kiht ie.
Mweidohng kiht se en patopato nan sapwamwail. Kumwail doareikitasang irail kan me men kamwomwkitala.” (Kahpwal oh mwomwla pahn imwisekla, oh irail kan me kahpwalihalahr wehiet pahn sohrala.

Eri, emen kisehn kadaudok en Depit pahn wiahla nanmwarki, oh e pahn ketin kaunda aramas akan ni loalopwoat oh limpoak. E pahn kin mwadang en wia dahme pwung, oh e pahn ketin tehk pwuhng pahrek en mie.)
Mehn Suda ahpw nda, “Se rongehr uwen aklapalap en mehn Mohap. Se wehwehki me re me pohnmwahso oh aklapalap, ahpw ar lokaiahn suwei kan sohte audepe.”

Mehn Mohap pahn sengiseng pwehki kahpwal akan me re lokolongki. Irail koaros pahn sengiseng ni ar pahn kin tamanda kisin tungoal mwahu kan me re kin tungoale nan kahnimw Kir Eres. E pahn sohla ar koapworopwor.

Mwetuwel kan limwahn Espon oh mwetin wain kan en Sipma mwomwlahr—mwetin wain pwuko me kin kasakawihala kaunen wehi kan. Mie ahnsou ehu me selin tuhkehn wain ko doulahng wasa doh me duwehte kahnimw Saser, oh doulahng palimesehn sapwtehno, oh pil lellahng ni palikapi palio Sehden Mehla.
Eri, met I mwahmwahieiki tuhkehn wain kan en Sipma duwehte ei mwahmwahieiki Saser. Pilenmesei kerkidier Espon oh Eleale, pwehki eh sohte ahnsoun dolung wahnsahpw me pahn kin kaparanda aramas akan.
Sohte emen me pereperen met nan sahpw kaselel wet. Sohte me ngisingis de kokoul nan mwetin wain kan. Sohte me tietiak kreip kan pwehn wiahkihda wain; ngilen peren imwiseklahr.
I weiweirengki ei pahtoukihla Mohap, mwahmwahieiki Kir Eres.
Mehn Mohap kan tihwohkilahr kolahng pohn ar nahnao ni wasahn kaudok kan oh ni ar tehnpas sarawi kan pwe re en kapakap, ahpw met pil sohte katepehiong irail.
Iet mahsen me KAUN-O ketin wia duwen Mohap mahs.
Eri, met KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Nan erein sounpar siluh, en Mohap reken kepwe pahn sohrala. Ni duwen tohtohn aramas, me malaulau me pahn mourla, ahpw re pahn luwetala.”
